topic_thesis: Corporate price hikes aren't just inflation; they are a calculated strategy to maintain profit margins at the direct expense of your household purchasing power.
strategic_angle: We expose the 'Double-Dip' strategy: Companies are currently executing a cumulative 7-9% price hike in Q1, with an additional 3-4% planned for Q2, effectively draining your savings to protect their EPS (Earnings Per Share) while blaming 'market forces'.
target_emotion: Shock and immediate urge to check personal accounts
pinned_comment_text: Is your salary growing at 13% to match these hidden hikes? If not, you're getting poorer every month. Comment 'GUIDE' for our list of sectors currently price-gouging the most! 📉👇
tamil_adaptation_directive: Focus on the 'Middle Class Budget' pain. Use Tanglish terms like 'Price hike-ah vechu unga wallet-ah empty panraanga' and 'Salary growth vs Inflation gap'. Emphasize that 'Bank Manager-o illa Corporate-o, unga pocket-ah paathudhan irukaanga'.
source_signal: Consumer anxiety regarding rising cost of living and stagnant wage growth.
